## Highlights
### Improved
- Update notes leave out changes that only reach iPhone and iPad, and link to the release's page on crestbrowser.com. - Every long press takes the same half second, and a Sub-Space sits the same distance in from its Space in every list. - Addresses ending in .test count as local everywhere: the developer toolbar turns on for them, and a typed one opens over HTTP first.
### Fixed
- What's New in Settings › About lists the newest changes in your version of Crest, and only the ones that reach your device. - A page in a language written in another script, such as Traditional Chinese for a reader of Simplified Chinese, is offered translation.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
